articles.title: FRC Appoints Christopher Lynch to Board of Directors, Strengthening Data and AI Leadership
articles.mainIdea: FRC Appoints Christopher Lynch to Board of Directors, Strengthening Data and AI Leadership
articles.summary: PR Newswire: FRC Appoints Christopher Lynch to Board of Directors, Strengthening Data and AI Leadership. FRC today announced the appointment of Christopher Lynch to its Board of Directors. Lynch joins Executive Chairman Alan Marc Smith, further strengthening the company's strategic leadership, governance, and long-term growth focus.

articles.mainIdea: How Investors May Respond To Cisco (CSCO) Supreme Court Appeal On Alleged Human Rights Abuses
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How Investors May Respond To Cisco (CSCO) Supreme Court Appeal On Alleged Human Rights Abuses. Cisco Systems is facing renewed attention after asking the U.S. Supreme Court to dismiss a lawsuit alleging its technology enabled human rights abuses against Falun Gong practitioners in China under the Alien Tort Statute and Torture Victim Protection Act.
